channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Patrick Dumont | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Patrick Dumont from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Adam Silver on Patrick Dumont
item.description:
Adam Silver:

“It's just started. We hired a search firm. Tremendous interest in the job. We are interested in having the women come here. In fact, you were at an event this afternoon and again Patrick Dumont who oversees the property here said, let's get a deal done. So I think I know there's many WNBA teams that would love to play internationally and this is a beautiful arena, it's a great opportunity here so we hope to make that happen fairly quickly.”

Adam Silver on Patrick Dumont, Oct 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Miriam Adelson, Patrick Dumont
item.description:
In an interview today, Mark Cuban told @townbrad:

“I get asked fairly often if I would be part of a group if they could buy the team. I tell them all the same thing: I don’t see the (Dumont and Adelson families) selling.”

Mark Cuban on Miriam Adelson, Patrick Dumont, Feb 11, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Nico Harrison, Patrick Dumont
item.description:
“Nico’s my guy. Obviously, he played a huge part of getting me here and wanting me to fulfill his vision, in a sense, that he saw. It was definitely tough. ...It’s the business of basketball. Once I had those conversations [with Harrison and Dumont], I was able to move forward and continue to rehab and get back on the floor and try to compete.”

Anthony Davis on Nico Harrison, Patrick Dumont, Nov 26, 2025. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Patrick Dumont
item.description:
#Mavs coach Jason Kidd on his new contract extension:

“I’m grateful for the belief that Patrick & Nico have in me, and the trust we’ve built while working together to construct a team that Dallas can be proud of. We have a great group of players here who love basketball, are talented & coachable. There’s mutual respect across all departments, and Patrick & Nico set the tone for what we are trying to accomplish here. It’s even more special that I can continue to coach the team that drafted me, and where I was able to win a title as a player. I’m looking forward to what’s ahead & continuing to work toward bringing another championship back to Dallas.”

Jason Kidd on Patrick Dumont, Oct 14, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Patrick Dumont
item.description:
Mark Cuban:

“Well, it's going to be tough because we don't have enough three-point shooters, which is part of the problem, right? So, that was a long time complaining about that. We spent a lot of hours over the summer talking about just that. And that's something Patrick and I have talked about, right? You know, it's kind of a triangle. It's not like Nico and I talking about it. It's Nico talking to Patrick, and me talking to Patrick, and it's his job to assimilate all that and make a decision.”

Mark Cuban on Patrick Dumont, Aug 27, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Patrick Dumont
item.description:
Nico Harrison said he was not told by #Mavs governor Patrick Dumont that he had to trade Luka Doncic:

“Not at all. Patrick reminds me of the leadership that I had at Nike and a really good leader doesn't tell the people that work for him what to do. It's a collective, well thought out process to make a big move like that. Also, unfortunately, I'm super stubborn so someone telling me to do something doesn't work too well for me.”

Luka Doncic on Patrick Dumont, Apr 21, 2025. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Adam Silver on Mark Cuban, Patrick Dumont
item.description:
“I think the situation was very different in Dallas. There was a clear change in control of the franchise to Patrick Dumont and his family. Any decision as to what Mark's role would be in basketball operations was a function of an arrangement to be made between Mark Cuban and Patrick. The ultimate governance was absolutely clear, as presented to our board, that the last word on any basketball activities or any significant decision for the franchise would be made by Patrick. I think Mark has acknowledged that, as I've obviously seen some of his commentary on the trade.”

Adam Silver on Mark Cuban, Patrick Dumont, Mar 28, 2025. Source: marcstein.substack.com.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Luka Doncic, Patrick Dumont
item.description:
Mark Cuban:

“If I had any influence, the Luka Doncic trade wouldn't happen. I was just as dumbfounded as everybody else. After I sold the Mavericks, the new owner Patrick Dumont decided that 'Ok, in Nico we trust.' So, here we are.”

Mark Cuban on Luka Doncic, Patrick Dumont, Mar 21, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Patrick Dumont
item.description:
Asked Nico Harrison about his conversation with #Mavs governor Patrick Dumont when he introduced the idea of trading Luka Doncic:

“The first time? He laughed at me. No, I mean Patrick, he's the owner, obviously he's the ultimate decision maker, but he entrusts in J-Kidd & I to lead this team and he's putting the trust into us. And then obviously you gotta get judged on the performance that you've done as a leader. And at some point, if it doesn't work out, then I'll be judged for that.”

Luka Doncic on Patrick Dumont, Feb 2, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Nico Harrison on Miriam Adelson, Patrick Dumont
item.description:
Mike Curtis:Nico Harrison on Miriam Adelson/Patrick Dumont's willingness to spend:

“I don't think money's going to be an object. It's about bringing in the right people. We want to win. We have to be smart about it.”

Nico Harrison on Miriam Adelson, Patrick Dumont, Jun 21, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Adam Silver on Mark Cuban, Patrick Dumont
item.description:
“I’ve talked to Mark [Cuban] and have run into him several times over the course of the last few months and have begun much more involved with Patrick Dumont as the governor of the team,”

Adam Silver on Mark Cuban, Patrick Dumont, Jun 13, 2024. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Patrick Dumont
item.description:
Kidd:

“I truly believe Patrick and Nico are building a championship team, and I'm happy to be a part of it.”

Jason Kidd on Patrick Dumont, May 6, 2024. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Patrick Dumont
item.description:
“I mean, financially, we're in a far better position this afternoon than we were yesterday afternoon to be able to compete like that. So what did [Houston Rockets owner] Tilman [Fertitta] say about being a middle-class billionaire? Those are facts in this day and age. It really matters. So having the partnership and having eventually new and deeper revenue sources allows us to compete better. I talked to Patrick a lot and Miriam and Sivan, and they're committed to winning.”

Mark Cuban on Patrick Dumont, Dec 27, 2023. Source: ESPN.
